name: Human
description: No particular gift, no particular weakness — humans make up most of the merchant houses on the road for a reason.

name: Dwarf
description: Stout, armor-minded, and hard to knock off a wagon seat. Dwarven caravans favor iron over speed.

name: Elf
description: Quick on the road and quicker to notice trouble before it notices you. Well regarded by the Order of the Arcane.

name: Half-Orc
description: Raised as much on the frontier as in any city. Hits hard, and the Enforcers never quite trust that.

name: Halfling
description: Small, light-footed, and able to pack a cart like nobody's business. Not built for a straight fight.
